## Source
AwesomeKit is a cutting-edge, blazingly fast toolkit that empowers developers to unlock their full potential. With over 50 000 lines of meticulously crafted code and 12 built-in plugins, it seamlessly integrates into your workflow. Whether you are a beginner or a seasoned professional, AwesomeKit has got you covered. Get started today and join the revolution!

## Gold edit
AwesomeKit is a toolkit for building CLI utilities. The core is about 50 000 lines of code; 12 plugins are bundled. Setup instructions are in the docs folder.
